items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: '40s, I heard--I think it was the '40s--somebody told me William Randolph Hearst used to come down to the Alabam, and Orson Welles used to come to the Alabam and a lot of movie people would come down to see the shows.

ctx.x: Well, after Mosby left, see, it was so uncertain, they didn't have many white people come down there. And we had big Saturday nights, big Thursday nights and big Sunday nights, and that was about all. See, Thursday night, you know, has always been a big night when all the cooks and things are off, and that's when all the dances were, and then Saturday night, and Sundays. The rest of the nights are just...you know--make expenses you're lucky. See? So that's the way it is. I don't know how it is now.

Well, during the '40s, I heard--I think it was the '40s--somebody told me William Randolph Hearst used to come down to the Alabam, and Orson Welles used to come to the Alabam and a lot of movie people would come down to see the shows.
